title: cron.parse raises IndexError when opening the dashboard
body:
Environment

Lattice version 3.0.1; operating system Ubuntu 24.04 LTS; server region eu-central-1.

Steps

How to trigger it:
* Start by opening the dashboard.
* Use an input with an odd number of rows.
* Watch the log for the traceback below.

Expected

No traceback; opening the dashboard normally takes a few seconds.

Actual

Every row works except the last row, which raises. Whatever the input size, it is always the last row that fails.

Frequency

Reproduces roughly one run in three.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:49 in loop
lattice/ui/view.py:213 in refresh
lattice/report/live.py:63 in tiles
lattice/sched/cron.py:282 in parse
IndexError: list index out of range
